priorSuccessfulOwnAVD.name: DeadSignal_Release_QA
priorSuccessfulOwnAVD.note: Qcow2 metadata clean does not verify guest filesystem health. Userdata allocation difference indicates different initialization progress, not a confirmed root cause.

evidenceLimits: App was never installed on failed AVD; failure cannot establish an APK defect.
No guest kernel or guest logcat captured during the two failed boots, so boot stage and root cause remain unknown.
ADB offline means not connected/responding; not a definitive full-OS boot verdict.
Vulkan warning occurred in previously successful boot and alone is not fatal evidence.
SwiftShader indirect still used ANGLE/Vulkan; it was not an explicit Vulkan-disabled boot.
No retry of the failed AVD was performed in this diagnostic turn.

alternatives.option: Google Play pre-launch report after authorized test-track upload
alternatives.limits: Device-lab capacity and app eligibility mean report generation is not guaranteed. Basic crawler does not replace direct play/save/control checks; game-loop support may be needed for useful game coverage.

alternatives.option: Physical Android device using signed QA APK or Play internal-test delivery
alternatives.limits: No physical adb device connected. Upload-key QA APK and Google-managed app-signing APK have different certificates; preserve any human game data and do not overwrite an incompatible installation.

alternatives.option: Clone stopped previously successful own QA AVD into a new isolated path
alternatives.limits: Copy only own initialized QA profile; leave original and all other emulators untouched. Clone contains old debug-signed app, so install of upload-signed APK requires removing only that app inside disposable clone after explicit GO. This would test release configuration without repeating failed cold initialization, but CUA emulator access remains unavailable.

alternatives.option: Another already installed official API system-image
alternatives.limits: Only API36 installed. New images/SDK updates would require separate authorized download and possible license decisions; none performed.

Official troubleshooting documents -feature -Vulkan for GLES graphics problems. It is distinct from SwiftShader indirect but is not a proven fix for this offline failure and does not justify retrying the same failed AVD.

sources.supports: 35.6.11 date and newer graphics fixes; no exact M5/macOS26.6 offline failure established
Apple Silicon Vulkan limitations and documented rendering options
Pre-launch automation, capacity limits, game crawler coverage limits
